build_mutator_instance: build a Mutator instance with a numpy RandomState for evolutionary algorithm mutations
run_discrete_mutation: run discrete mutation on a parent array using the classical 1+1 evolution strategy
run_rlsmutation: run RLS one-variable mutation on a parent array with a specified arity
run_crossover: run crossover between a parent and donor using onepoint twopoint max or min strategy
run_getroulette: run roulette tournament selection on an archive to find the best pessimistic confidence bound
